mcp.intro: The MCP sees only the roots listed here, and everything inside them. Private nodes stay hidden even inside a root. Agentic tasks inside a root can also be written; everything else is read-only.
mcp.none: No roots yet — the MCP sees nothing.
mcp.hidden: Private — the MCP cannot see it
mcp.missing: A node that no longer exists
